Verses.VerseAr: طٰسٓمٓ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ta, Sin, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡـكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These are the Verses of the enlightening Book.

Verses.VerseAr: نَـتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ نَّبَاِ مُوۡسٰى وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ بِالۡحَـقِّ لِقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Esteemed Beloved!) We recite to you from the true account of Musa (Moses) and Pharaoh for those who have believed.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ عَلَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَجَعَلَ اَهۡلَهَا شِيَـعًا يَّسۡتَضۡعِفُ طَآٮِٕفَةً مِّنۡهُمۡ يُذَبِّحُ اَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡىٖ نِسَآءَهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Certainly Pharaoh had become an arrogant rebel (i.e. a tyrannical despot) in the land and he had divided the citizens of his (state) into (various) sects (and groups). He had oppressed and weakened one of these groups (the population comprising the Children of Israel). He used to kill their sons (to crush their future strength) and let their women live (to increase their number without men and spread immorality and indecency among them). Surely he was one of those who rouse disruption.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ نَّمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَنَجۡعَلَهُمۡ اَٮِٕمَّةً وَّنَجۡعَلَهُمُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We wanted to do favour to the people who had been weakened in the land (through oppression, exploitation and deprivation of rights and freedom) and make them leaders (of the oppressed people) and inheritors (of the throne of the kingdom);

Verses.VerseAr: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَجُنُوۡدَهُمَا مِنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَحۡذَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And to give them governance and power in the land and show Pharaoh and Haman and their armies (the revolution) that they used to fear.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰٓى اُمِّ مُوۡسٰٓى اَنۡ اَرۡضِعِيۡهِ‌ۚ فَاِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَاَلۡقِيۡهِ فِىۡ الۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِىۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنِىۡۚ اِنَّا رَآدُّوۡهُ اِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِالُوۡهُ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We revealed to the heart of the mother of Musa (Moses): ‘Suckle him on, but when you fear (for his life), put him afloat into the river and be not afraid (of this situation) nor grieve. Surely We shall bring him back to you and shall make him one of Our Messengers.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَالۡتَقَطَهٗۤ اٰلُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لِيَكُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَدُوًّا وَّحَزَنًا‌ ؕ اِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَجُنُوۡدَهُمَا كَانُوۡا خٰطِــِٕيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then Pharaoh’s family picked him up (from the river) so that (by the will of Allah) he proves for them an enemy and (a cause of) grief. Surely Pharaoh, Haman and their armies were the evildoers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَتِ امۡرَاَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنٍ لِّىۡ وَلَكَ‌ؕ لَا تَقۡتُلُوۡهُ ‌ۖ عَسٰٓى اَنۡ يَّـنۡفَعَنَاۤ اَوۡ نَـتَّخِذَهٗ وَلَدًا وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the wife of Pharaoh said (on seeing Musa [Moses]): ‘(This child) is coolness of eyes for me and for you; do not kill him. He may perhaps bring us benefit or we may adopt him as a son.’ And they were unaware (of the outcome of this plan).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَصۡبَحَ فُؤَادُ اُمِّ مُوۡسٰى فٰرِغًا‌ؕ اِنۡ كَادَتۡ لَـتُبۡدِىۡ بِهٖ لَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ رَّبَطۡنَا عَلٰى قَلۡبِهَا لِتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the heart of Musa’s (Moses’s) mother felt empty (of patience). And she would have nearly disclosed the secret (owing to her impatience), had We not energized her heart with the strength of peace and patience, so that she might remain one of the firm believers (in Allah’s promise).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَتۡ لِاُخۡتِهٖ قُصِّيۡهِ‌ فَبَصُرَتۡ بِهٖ عَنۡ جُنُبٍ وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (Musa’s [Moses’s] mother) said to his sister: ‘Follow him (to be aware of him).’ So she watched him from a distance but they were (completely) unaware.

Verses.VerseAr: وَحَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ الۡمَرَاضِعَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَقَالَتۡ هَلۡ اَدُلُّـكُمۡ عَلٰٓى اَهۡلِ بَيۡتٍ يَّكۡفُلُوۡنَهٗ لَـكُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهٗ نٰصِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We had in advance prohibited him from the feed of wet nurses. So (Musa’s [Moses’s] sister) said: ‘Shall I tell you about a family who will bring up this (child) for you and will (also) be his well-wisher?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَرَدَدۡنٰهُ اِلٰٓى اُمِّهٖ كَىۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ وَلِتَعۡلَمَ اَنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (this way) We returned Musa (Moses) to his mother so that her eyes might keep cool and so that she might not feel grieved and in order that she might know (with certitude) that Allah’s promise is true but most of the people do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ وَاسۡتَوٰٓى اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًا‌ؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِىۡ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Musa (Moses) reached his maturity and (the age of) moderation and stability, We honoured him with the Command (of Prophethood) and knowledge and wisdom. And that is how We reward the righteous.

Verses.VerseAr: وَدَخَلَ الۡمَدِيۡنَةَ عَلٰى حِيۡنِ غَفۡلَةٍ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيۡهَا رَجُلَيۡنِ يَقۡتَتِلٰنِ هٰذَا مِنۡ شِيۡعَتِهٖ وَهٰذَا مِنۡ عَدُوِّهٖ‌ۚ فَاسۡتَغَاثَهُ الَّذِىۡ مِنۡ شِيۡعَتِهٖ عَلَى الَّذِىۡ مِنۡ عَدُوِّهٖۙ فَوَكَزَهٗ مُوۡسَىٰ فَقَضٰى عَلَيۡهِ‌ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنۡ عَمَلِ الشَّيۡطٰنِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَدُوٌّ مُّضِلٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Musa (Moses) entered the city (in Egypt) at a time when its people were lying (asleep) unaware. There he found two men fighting with each other, one from his (own) party (the Children of Israel) and the other from his enemies (the people of Pharaoh). The man from his own party asked him for help against the other who was from his enemies. So Musa (Moses) struck him with his fist and killed him. (Then) he said: ‘This is Satan’s work (which I have committed); no doubt he is an open misleading enemy.’

Words.MeaningEn: so Musa struck him with his fist
**so Musa struck him with his fist

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِىۡ فَاغۡفِرۡ لِىۡ فَغَفَرَ لَهٗ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Musa - Moses) submitted: ‘O my Lord, no doubt I have wronged my soul; so bless me with forgiveness.’ Then He forgave him. Surely He is the Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ ظَهِيۡرًا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Moreover) he submitted: ‘O my Lord, because of Your favour (of forgiveness) You have blessed me with, I shall never be a helper of the wrongdoers.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَصۡبَحَ فِىۡ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ خَآٮِٕفًا يَّتَرَقَّبُ فَاِذَا الَّذِىۡ اسۡتَـنۡصَرَهٗ بِالۡاَمۡسِ يَسۡتَصۡرِخُهٗ‌ؕ قَالَ لَهٗ مُوۡسٰٓى اِنَّكَ لَـغَوِىٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Musa (Moses), anxious and afraid, kept waiting till morning (to discover what would happen next). Then suddenly the man who sought his help the day before was crying out to him for help (again). Musa (Moses) said to him: ‘Surely you are the one who has truly lost the right path.’

Words.MeaningEn: cried out to him for help

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّاۤ اَنۡ اَرَادَ اَنۡ يَّبۡطِشَ بِالَّذِىۡ هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهُمَاۙ قَالَ يٰمُوۡسٰٓى اَتُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ تَقۡتُلَنِىۡ كَمَا قَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًۢا بِالۡاَمۡسِ‌‌ۖ اِنۡ تُرِيۡدُ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ جَبَّارًا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا تُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُصۡلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when Musa (Moses) decided to catch hold of the person who was an enemy to both of them, he exclaimed: ‘O Musa (Moses), do you want to kill me (too) as you killed a man the day before? You intend only to become a tyrant in the land and you do not desire to become one of the reformers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌ مِّنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ يَسۡعٰى قَالَ يٰمُوۡسٰٓى اِنَّ الۡمَلَاَ يَاۡتَمِرُوۡنَ بِكَ لِيَـقۡتُلُوۡكَ فَاخۡرُجۡ اِنِّىۡ لَـكَ مِنَ النّٰصِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And a man came running from the far end of the city and said: ‘O Musa (Moses), the chiefs (of the people of Pharaoh) are counselling about you to kill you, so depart (from here). Surely I am of your well-wishers.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآٮِٕفًا يَّتَرَقَّبُ‌ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِىۡ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Musa (Moses), afraid and waiting for (Allah’s help), went off from there. He prayed: ‘O my Lord, deliver me from the oppressing people.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسٰى رَبِّىۡۤ اَنۡ يَّهۡدِيَنِىۡ سَوَآءَ السَّبِيۡلِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when he moved towards Madyan, he said: ‘I hope my Lord will show me the straight path (to take me to the desired destination).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيۡهِ اُمَّةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ يَسۡقُوۡنَ   وَوَجَدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمُ امۡرَاَتَيۡنِ تَذُوۡدٰنِ‌ۚ قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُمَا‌ؕ قَالَـتَا لَا نَسۡقِىۡ حَتّٰى يُصۡدِرَ الرِّعَآءُ‌؄ وَاَبُوۡنَا شَيۡخٌ كَبِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when he arrived at the watering (well) of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering (their flocks). And on a side he saw two women, withdrawn, holding back (their goats. Musa [Moses]) asked: ‘Why are you (standing) in this condition?’ Both said: ‘We cannot water (our goats) till the shepherds take back their flocks and our father is an aged man.’

Words.MeaningEn: (is the) matter with both of you

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَقٰى لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلّٰٓى اِلَى الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَىَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٍ فَقِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So he watered their (flocks) and then turned back to the shade and submitted: ‘O Lord, I am in need of whatever good You may send down to me.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَجَآءَتۡهُ اِحۡدٰٮہُمَا تَمۡشِىۡ عَلَى اسۡتِحۡيَآءٍ قَالَتۡ اِنَّ اَبِىۡ يَدۡعُوۡكَ لِيَجۡزِيَكَ اَجۡرَ مَا سَقَيۡتَ لَـنَا‌ؕ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهٗ وَقَصَّ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَصَصَۙ قَالَ لَا تَخَفۡ‌ نَجَوۡتَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then (after a while) one of those two (girls) came to him walking modestly. She said: ‘My father invites you so that he may reward you for (your labour in) watering (the flocks) for us. So when Musa (Moses) came to (Shu‘aib, the father of those girls,) and narrated to him (the preceding) incidents, he said: ‘Do not fear. You are safe and secure from the oppressive people.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ اِحۡدٰٮہُمَا يٰۤاَبَتِ اسْتَاْجِرۡهُ‌ اِنَّ خَيۡرَ مَنِ اسۡتَـاْجَرۡتَ الۡقَوِىُّ الۡاَمِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: One of those (girls) said: ‘O (my) respectable father, take him (into your service). Surely the best person you can employ is the one who is strong and trustworthy (and he is worthy of this assignment).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنِّىۡۤ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اُنۡكِحَكَ اِحۡدَى ابۡنَتَىَّ هٰتَيۡنِ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ تَاۡجُرَنِىۡ ثَمٰنِىَ حِجَجٍ‌ۚ فَاِنۡ اَتۡمَمۡتَ عَشۡرًا فَمِنۡ عِنۡدِكَ‌ۚ وَمَاۤ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اَشُقَّ عَلَيۡكَ‌ؕ سَتَجِدُنِىۡۤ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said (to Musa - Moses): ‘I intend to marry to you one of my two daughters by (the dower) that you serve me on hire for eight years but if you complete ten (years), it will be (a favour) from you. And I do not want to make it hard for you. If Allah wills you will find me of the pious.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ بَيۡنِىۡ وَبَيۡنَكَ‌ؕ اَيَّمَا الۡاَجَلَيۡنِ قَضَيۡتُ فَلَا عُدۡوَانَ عَلَىَّ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰى مَا نَقُوۡلُ وَكِيۡلٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said: ‘This (agreement) is (settled) between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I complete, I will not be forced. And Allah is the Custodian over what we say.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا قَضٰى مُوۡسَى الۡاَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِاَهۡلِهٖۤ اٰنَسَ مِنۡ جَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ نَارًا‌ۚ قَالَ لِاَهۡلِهِ امۡكُثُوۡۤا اِنِّىۡۤ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًا‌ لَّعَلِّىۡۤ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوۡ جَذۡوَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when Musa (Moses) completed the appointed term and set out with his wife, he saw a fire in the direction of Tur. (That was a flash of Absolute Beauty which caught his heart and fascinated him.) He said to his wife: ‘Stay (here). I have seen a fire. I may bring you some news (about Him) from that (fire in Whose pursuit I have long been wandering), or (I may bring you) some burning brand from the (febrile) fire so that you (too) may feel the burn.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّاۤ اَتٰٮهَا نُوۡدِىَ مِنۡ شَاطِیٴِ الۡوَادِ الۡاَيۡمَنِ فِىۡ الۡبُقۡعَةِ الۡمُبٰرَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ اَنۡ يّٰمُوۡسٰٓى اِنِّىۡۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When Musa (Moses) reached there, a call was made from the right of (the blessed Tur) valley from a tree (located) in a blessed spot: ‘O Musa (Moses), verily I am Allah, the Sustainer of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡ اَلۡقِ عَصَاكَ‌ؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰى مُدۡبِرًا وَّلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡ‌ؕ يٰمُوۡسٰٓى اَقۡبِلۡ وَلَا تَخَفۡ‌ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡاٰمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And throw your stick (on the ground).’ So when Musa (Moses) saw it moving fast coiling and curling as if it was a snake, he turned his back, jogged off and did not look behind. (The Voice said:) ‘O Musa (Moses), come forth and do not fear. Surely you are of the secure.

Verses.VerseAr: اُسۡلُكۡ يَدَكَ فِىۡ جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍ وَّاضۡمُمۡ اِلَيۡكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهۡبِ‌ فَذٰنِكَ بُرۡهَانٰنِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۟ٮِٕهٖؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ‏‏‏
Verses.VerseEn: Put your hand inside your collar opening. It will come out shining white without any disease. And flex your hand close to your (breast to remove) fear. These two Signs from your Lord are for (sending to) Pharaoh and his courtiers (to observe). Surely they are disobedient people.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡ قَتَلۡتُ مِنۡهُمۡ نَفۡسًا فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّقۡتُلُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) submitted: ‘O Lord, I killed one of them, so I fear they will kill me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَخِىۡ هٰرُوۡنُ هُوَ اَفۡصَحُ مِنِّىۡ لِسَانًا فَاَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِىَ رِدۡاً يُّصَدِّقُنِىۡٓ‌ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And my brother Harun (Aaron) is more communicative and eloquent in speech than I, so send him with me as a helper that he may bear me out. And I (also) fear that they will reject me.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِاَخِيۡكَ وَنَجۡعَلُ لَـكُمَا سُلۡطٰنًا فَلَا يَصِلُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكُمَا‌‌ ۛ‌ۚ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ ‌ۛ‌ۚ اَنۡتُمَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘We shall strengthen your arm with your brother and shall create for both of you dread and dominance (in the hearts of the people and in the impact of your endeavours). So they will not be able to reach you (to do harm) because of Our Signs. You two and your followers will triumph and prevail.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالُوۡا مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّفۡتَرًى وَمَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِىۡۤ اٰبَآٮِٕنَا الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when Musa (Moses) came to them with Our clear and enlightening Signs they said: ‘This is nothing but invented magic; we (never) heard of these things among our ancestors.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰى رَبِّىۡۤ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡهُدٰى مِنۡ عِنۡدِهٖ وَمَنۡ تَكُوۡنُ لَهٗ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Musa (Moses) said: ‘My Lord knows best the one who has brought Guidance from Him and (also) the one for whom the House of the Hereafter will be the (best) end. Surely the wrongdoers will not prosper.’

Words.MeaningEn: the od end in the Hereafter
the od end in the Hereafter

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يٰۤاَيُّهَا الۡمَلَاُ مَا عَلِمۡتُ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرِىۡ‌ۚ فَاَوۡقِدۡ لِىۡ يٰهَامٰنُ عَلَى الطِّيۡنِ فَاجۡعَل لِّىۡ صَرۡحًا لَّعَلِّىۡۤ اَطَّلِعُ اِلٰٓى اِلٰهِ مُوۡسٰىۙ وَاِنِّىۡ لَاَظُنُّهٗ مِنَ الۡـكٰذِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Pharaoh said: ‘O courtiers, I do not know any god other than me for you. O Haman! Kindle a fire on clay (to bake bricks) for me; then build me a high tower (with them. Climbing it,) I may perhaps have an access to the Lord of Musa (Moses). And I regard him as one of the liars.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاسۡتَكۡبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُوۡدُهٗ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَـقِّ وَظَنُّوۡۤا اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَـيۡنَا لَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And he (Pharaoh) himself and his warriors were unjust in the land doing arrogance and defiance and thought they would not be brought back to Us.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ وَجُنُوۡدَهٗ فَنَبَذۡنٰهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡيَمِّ‌ۚ فَانْظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We seized him and his forces (in the torment) and threw them into the sea. Observe then how (terrible) was the end of the tyrants!

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَٮِٕمَّةً يَّدۡعُوۡنَ اِلَى النَّارِ‌ۚ وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ لَا يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We made them the leaders (of the inmates of Hell), for they used to invite (people) towards Hell. And they will not be given any help on the Day of Resurrection.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَتۡبَعۡنٰهُمۡ فِىۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا لَـعۡنَةً‌ ۚ وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمَقۡبُوۡحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We made a curse to chase them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection (as well) they will be (counted) among the miserable.

Words.MeaningEn: And We caused to follow them

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَاۤ اَهۡلَكۡنَا الۡقُرُوۡنَ الۡاُوۡلٰى بَصَآٮِٕرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحۡمَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely after (this scenario that) We had destroyed the former (defiant) communities, We gave Musa (Moses) the Book which was (a rich source of) vision, guidance and mercy for the people so that they might take advice.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا كُنۡتَ بِجَانِبِ الۡغَرۡبِىِّ اِذۡ قَضَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوۡسَى الۡاَمۡرَ وَمَا كُنۡتَ مِنَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you were not (present at that time) on the western side (of Tur) when We sent the Command (of Prophethood) towards Musa (Moses), nor were you among (those seventy people who were) witnesses (to the Revelation to Musa [Moses]. So what else is this narration except the news of the Unseen?)

Verses.VerseAr: وَلٰـكِنَّاۤ اَنۡشَاۡنَا قُرُوۡنًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡعُمُرُ‌ۚ وَمَا كُنۡتَ ثَاوِيًا فِىۡۤ اَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ تَـتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَاۙ وَلٰـكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But We raised many generations (successively after Musa [Moses]) and long ages passed over them. Nor were you living among the people of Madyan (like Musa - Moses and Shu‘aib) reciting Our Verses to them. But it is for Us to send (you exalting with tidings of the Unseen).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا كُنۡتَ بِجَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ اِذۡ نَادَيۡنَا وَلٰـكِنۡ رَّحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّاۤ اَتٰٮهُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And nor were you (present at that time) on the side of Tur when We called out Musa (Moses). But (enlightening you on all these matters of the Unseen) is an (exceptional) Mercy from your Lord so that (having awareness of these incidents) you may warn these people (of the torment of Allah) to whom no Warner has come before you, in order that they may accept admonition.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ تُصِيۡبَهُمۡ مُّصِيۡبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ فَيَقُوۡلُوۡا رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡتَ اِلَـيۡنَا رَسُوۡلاً فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ وَنَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We would not send any Messenger) if this was not the case that when some suffering should seize them due to their own evil deeds which they did, they would say: ‘O our Lord, why did You not send us any Messenger so that we might follow Your Revelations and become of the believers?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَـقُّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِنَا قَالُوۡا لَوۡلَاۤ اُوۡتِىَ مِثۡلَ مَاۤ اُوۡتِىَ مُوۡسٰى‌ؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَاۤ اُوۡتِىَ مُوۡسٰى مِنۡ قَبۡلُ‌ۚ قَالُوۡا سِحۡرٰنِ تَظَاهَرَا وَقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when the Truth came to them from Our Presence, they said: ‘Why has this (Messenger) not been given the (Signs) like those (Signs) which were given to Musa (Moses)?’ Did they not deny those (Signs) which were given to Musa (Moses) before this? They said: ‘Both (the Qur’an as well as the Torah) are magic (which) confirm and agree with each other.’ And they said: ‘We deny all (of them).’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِكِتٰبٍ مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ هُوَ اَهۡدٰى مِنۡهُمَاۤ اَتَّبِعۡهُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Bring some (other) book from Allah which guides better than these two, (then) I shall follow that if you are truthful (in your blames).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنۡ لَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَكَ فَاعۡلَمۡ اَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوٰٮهُ بِغَيۡرِ هُدًى مِّنَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِىۡ الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But if they do not accept what you say then know that (they do not have any logic); they merely follow their lusts. And who can be more astray than the one who follows his desire abandoning the Guidance from Allah? Surely Allah does not guide the wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ وَصَّلۡنَا لَهُمُ الۡقَوۡلَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In fact We kept sending for them successive commands (of the Qur’an) so that they might take direction and guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡـكِتٰبَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ هُمۡ بِهٖ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those whom We gave the Book before this they believe in this (Qur’an as well in the continuation of the same guidance).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا يُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَالُوۡۤا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۤ اِنَّهُ الۡحَـقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when (the Qur’an) is recited to them, they say: ‘We believe in it; verily, it is the Truth from our Lord. In fact We had become Muslims (i.e. the yielding) even before this.’

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُؤۡتَوۡنَ اَجۡرَهُمۡ مَّرَّتَيۡنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا وَيَدۡرَءُوۡنَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is these people who will be given their reward twice because they remained steadfast and fend off evil with good and they spend in Our Way out of the Bounty We bestowed upon them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا سَمِعُوۡا اللَّغۡوَ اَعۡرَضُوۡا عَنۡهُ وَقَالُوۡا لَنَاۤ اَعۡمَالُنَا وَلَـكُمۡ اَعۡمَالُـكُمۡ  سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَا نَبۡتَغِىۡ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when they hear anything absurd they turn away from it and say: ‘For us are our deeds and for you are your deeds. Peace be upon you. We do not want (to adopt the mentality and conduct of) the ignorant. (Why should we give up our good for the sake of their evil?)’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّكَ لَا تَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ اَحۡبَبۡتَ وَلٰـكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ‌ؕ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُهۡتَدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The truth is that whoever you like (to bring on to the path of guidance) you do not yourself bring him on to the path of guidance. Instead, (it so happens that) whoever Allah pleases He makes him tread the path of guidance (through your mediation). And He knows best those who find the path of guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡۤا اِنۡ نَّتَّبِعِ الۡهُدٰى مَعَكَ نُـتَخَطَّفۡ مِنۡ اَرۡضِنَاؕ اَوَلَمۡ نُمَكِّنۡ لَّهُمۡ حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا يُّجۡبٰٓى اِلَيۡهِ ثَمَرٰتُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ رِّزۡقًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنَّا وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (the ignorant of its value) say: ‘If we follow the guidance in your company, we will be snatched out of our land.’ Have We not made them settle in (this) secure and peaceful Sanctuary (Makka - your own land) where all kinds of fruits are supplied (from all over the world) as sustenance from Us? But most of them do not know (for whose sake this whole process operates).

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَـكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍۢ بَطِرَتۡ مَعِيۡشَتَهَا‌ۚ فَتِلۡكَ مَسٰكِنُهُمۡ لَمۡ تُسۡكَنۡ مِّنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلاً‌ ؕ وَّكُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And how many towns have We destroyed that became arrogant and ungrateful on account of their prosperous economies! So here are their (ruined) houses that have been inhabited after them but little. And We alone are the inheritors and owners (in the end).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهۡلِكَ الۡقُرٰى حَتّٰى يَبۡعَثَ فِىۡۤ اُمِّهَا رَسُوۡلاً يَّتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا‌ۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهۡلِكِىۡ الۡقُرٰٓى اِلَّا وَاَهۡلُهَا ظٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord does not destroy the towns until He sends to their capital city a Messenger who recites to them Our Verses. And We do not destroy towns unless their dwellers are given to oppression.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اُوۡتِيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَزِيۡنَتُهَا‌ۚ وَمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰى‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whatever you have been given are but provisions of the worldly life, its charms and beauty. But what is (yet) with Allah is far better (than this) and eternal. Do you not understand (this fact)?

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ وَّعَدۡنٰهُ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لَاقِيۡهِ كَمَنۡ مَّتَّعۡنٰهُ مَتَاعَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مِنَ الۡمُحۡضَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Can he to whom We have made an excellent promise (pertaining to Hereafter) and who becomes one to attain to it be like the (ill-fated) one We have given the good things of worldly life then (owing to ingratitude for the bounties) becomes of those who will be brought forth on the Last Day (for punishment)?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ فَيَـقُوۡلُ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُنۡتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when (Allah) will call them and say: ‘Where are those that you regarded as My partners and considered them (gods)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلُ رَبَّنَا هٰٓؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيۡنَ اَغۡوَيۡنَاۚ اَغۡوَيۡنٰهُمۡ كَمَا غَوَيۡنَا‌ۚ تَبَرَّاۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ‌ مَا كَانُوۡۤا اِيَّانَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The people against whom the Command (of torment) has been proved will say: ‘O our Lord, it is these people who we misguided. We led them astray (the same way) as we (ourselves) lost the right path. We turn to You showing our disgust towards them and (in fact) they did not worship us. (They rather worshipped their lusts.)’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِيۡلَ ادۡعُوۡا شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَهُمۡ وَرَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَ‌ۚ لَوۡ اَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it will be said (to them): ‘Call your (self-made) partners.’ So they will call them but they (partners) will not respond to them and those people will see the torment. Would that they had taken guidance (in the world)!

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ فَيَـقُوۡلُ مَاذَاۤ اَجَبۡتُمُ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when (Allah) will call to them He will say: ‘What answer did you serve to the Messengers?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَعَمِيَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡاَنۡۢبَآءُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ فَهُمۡ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On that Day all information will become unknown to them and they will not be able to ask (even) one another.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَمَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَعَسٰٓى اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُفۡلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But whoever repents and believes and does pious deeds will surely be of those who are successful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَرَبُّكَ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخۡتَارُ‌ؕ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الۡخِيَرَةُ‌ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord creates whatever He wills and chooses (whom He pleases for Prophethood and for the right of intercession). These (disbelievers and polytheists) have no authority or choice (in this matter). Holy is Allah the Glorious and Exalted far above (the false gods) that they associate as partners (with Allah)!

Verses.VerseAr: وَرَبُّكَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوۡرُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord knows (all) what their breasts hide (inside) and what they make known.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ؕ لَـهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِىۡ الۡاُوۡلٰى وَالۡاٰخِرَةِ‌ وَلَـهُ الۡحُكۡمُ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He alone is Allah; apart from Him there is no God. All praise belongs to Him in the world and in the Hereafter. And His alone is the (true) Command and Rule and to Him alone will you be returned.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ الَّيۡلَ سَرۡمَدًا اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَنۡ اِلٰـهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِ يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِضِيَآءٍ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَسۡمَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Just answer: If Allah prolongs the night over you till the Day of Resurrection (then) what god is there besides Allah who will bring you light? Do you not hear (these words)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرۡمَدًا اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَنۡ اِلٰـهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِ يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِلَيۡلٍ تَسۡكُنُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Just tell me this (as well): If Allah prolongs the day over you till the Day of Judgment, (then) what god is there besides Allah who will bring you night in which you may take rest? Do you not see?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لِتَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it is out of His Mercy that He has made night and day for you so that at night you may take rest and (during the day) you may seek His Bounty (sustenance) and so that you may become grateful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ فَيَـقُوۡلُ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُنۡتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when He will call to them and say: ‘Where are they who you regarded as My partners and considered (gods)?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَزَعۡنَا مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيۡدًا فَقُلۡنَا هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡ فَعَلِمُوۡۤا اَنَّ الۡحَـقَّ لِلّٰهِ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We shall take out from every Umma (Community) a witness and We shall then say (to the disbelievers): ‘Bring your proof.’ Then they will know that the Truth belongs to Allah and all (the lies) they used to invent will disappear from them.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ قَارُوۡنَ كَانَ مِنۡ قَوۡمِ مُوۡسَىٰ فَبَغٰى عَلَيۡهِمۡ‌ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡكُنُوۡزِ مَاۤ اِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهٗ لَـتَـنُوۡٓاُ بِالۡعُصۡبَةِ اُولِىۡ الۡقُوَّةِ اِذۡ قَالَ لَهٗ قَوۡمُهٗ لَا تَفۡرَحۡ‌ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡفَرِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No doubt Qarun (Korah) was of the people of Musa (Moses) but he oppressed them. And We gave him so much of treasures that it was hard for a powerful party of strong men to (carry) his keys while his people said to him: ‘Do not be arrogant and conceited (out of rejoicing). Verily Allah does not like those who gloat.

Verses.VerseAr: وَابۡتَغِ فِيۡمَاۤ اٰتٰٮكَ اللّٰهُ الدَّارَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ‌ وَلَا تَنۡسَ نَصِيۡبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنۡيَا‌ وَاَحۡسِنۡ كَمَاۤ اَحۡسَنَ اللّٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ‌ وَلَا تَبۡغِ الۡـفَسَادَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And seek the home of the Hereafter with what (wealth) Allah has given you and (also) do not forget your share of the world. And do (such) good (to the people) as Allah has done good to you. But do not look for (ways to spread) evil and terror in the land (through oppression, accumulation of wealth and exploitation). Surely Allah does not like those who violate peace.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اُوۡتِيۡتُهٗ عَلٰى عِلۡمٍ عِنۡدِىۡ‌ؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدۡ اَهۡلَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مِنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ مَنۡ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنۡهُ قُوَّةً وَّاَكۡثَرُ جَمۡعًا‌ؕ وَلَا يُسۡــَٔلُ عَنۡ ذُنُوۡبِهِمُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘(Why should I spend this capital for the good of people and society?) This wealth has been given to me only on the basis of (the professional) knowledge and skill I possess.’ Did he not know that Allah had really destroyed before him many communities who were far stronger than him in might and far ahead in accumulating (wealth and manpower)? And the culprits will not be asked (for fact-finding or any excuse or reason) about their sins (at the time of destruction).

Verses.VerseAr: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ فِىۡ زِيۡنَتِهٖ‌ؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا يٰلَيۡتَ لَـنَا مِثۡلَ مَاۤ اُوۡتِىَ قَارُوۡنُۙ اِنَّهٗ لَذُوۡ حَظٍّ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then he went forth before his people (fully) adorned and ornamented. (Seeing his apparent pomp and show) those who were desirous of worldly life could not help saying: ‘Would that there were such (affluence and riches) for us (as well) as Qarun (Korah) has been given! Surely he has mighty fortune.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوۡا الۡعِلۡمَ وَيۡلَـكُمۡ ثَوَابُ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ لِّمَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـاۚ وَّلَا يُلَقّٰٮهَاۤ اِلَّا الصّٰبِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (on the other side) those who had been granted knowledge (of the Truth) said: ‘Woe to you! Allah’s reward is (far) better (than this wealth and adornment) for him who has believed and is committed to pious deeds. But this (reward and compensation) will not be given except to those who keep patience.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَخَسَفۡنَا بِهٖ وَبِدَارِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهٗ مِنۡ فِئَةٍ يَّـنۡصُرُوۡنَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡتَصِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We sank him (Qarun [Korah]) and his house into the earth. So except Allah there was no (such) party that could help him (in saving from the torment). Nor could he stop the torment himself.

Words.MeaningEn: Then We caused to swallow up

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَصۡبَحَ الَّذِيۡنَ تَمَـنَّوۡا مَكَانَهٗ بِالۡاَمۡسِ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَيۡكَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُ‌ۚ لَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ مَّنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا‌ؕ وَيۡكَاَنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who were longing for his position and prominence the day before said (feeling sorry and regretful): ‘How amazing! Allah gives abundantly to whom He wills and sparingly (to whom He wills) of His servants. Had not Allah done favour to us, He would have sunk us (too). Ah! (It is now understood) that the disbelievers cannot attain to deliverance.’

Words.MeaningEn: He would have caused it to swallow us
**He would have caused it to swallow us.

Verses.VerseAr: تِلۡكَ الدَّارُ الۡاٰخِرَةُ نَجۡعَلُهَا لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ عُلُوًّا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا‌ؕ وَالۡعَاقِبَةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (This) is the Home of the Hereafter We have made for such people that neither seek violence and vanity nor mischief in the land. And good end is for the God-fearing.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهَا‌ۚ وَمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجۡزَى الَّذِيۡنَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever brings good, for him is reward better than that and whoever brings evil, then there is no compensation for the evildoers but equal to what they used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِىۡ فَرَضَ عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لَرَآدُّكَ اِلٰى مَعَادٍ‌ؕ قُل رَّبِّىۡۤ اَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡهُدٰى وَمَنۡ هُوَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely, the (Lord) Who has enjoined (the teaching, preaching and establishment of the system given in) the Qur’an upon you will bring you back (according to your desire) to the place of return (Mecca or the Hereafter with victory and success). Say: ‘My Lord knows best the one who brought guidance and (also) the one who is in open error.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا كُنۡتَ تَرۡجُوۡۤا اَنۡ يُّلۡقٰٓى اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبُ اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ‌ فَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ ظَهِيۡرًا لِّـلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Muslim Umma [Community] is addressed through the Prophet, blessings and peace be upon him:) And you did not expect that this (Book) shall be revealed to you, but it is (revealed by) the Mercy of your Lord. So never be a helper of the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ اُنۡزِلَتۡ اِلَيۡكَ‌ وَادۡعُ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ‌ وَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And never let these (disbelievers) turn you away from (implementing and preaching of) the Revelations of Allah after they have been sent down to you. And keep calling (the people) towards your Lord, and never become of those who associate partners with Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ‌ۘ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ كُلُّ شَىۡءٍ هَالِكٌ اِلَّا وَجۡهَهٗ‌ؕ لَـهُ الۡحُكۡمُ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And never call any other (self-made) god besides Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except He. Everything has to perish but He. His is the Command and to Him you (all) will be returned.
